children: SoSoValue has scheduled an SOSO supply unlock for December 2026. The schedule gives the month but does not specify a day. The unlock will release at least 19.31 million SOSO allocated to investors and team members.
Investors and team members can sell the tokens they receive once the lock ends. The amount that becomes available to sell equals 5.39% of the circulating supply.

title: SoSoValue: SOSO supply unlock releases at least 19.31 million tokens - Dec 2026
